note: BDO's ATM Savings, the everyday account there: a required monthly average daily balance of 2,000 pesos, and a 300-peso fee once the account falls below it for two consecutive months (the game charges it for any month below, not counting the first month's grace).

sources.title: BDO Unibank, ATM Savings
sources.said: Minimum MADB Requirement (1) ₱ 2,000 ... Falling Below Minimum Balance (3) ₱300 ... (3) Falling Below Minimum Balance Fee will be collected if account falls below the required minimum MADB for two consecutive months.
